content.short: Defiance Capital is a leading crypto investment firm with a focus on Defi and gaming.
content.description: Defiance Capital takes an active, hands-on approach, partnering with portfolio teams to bootstrap the network effects essential for scalable growth. Beyond funding, they offer strategic guidance on token economics, governance design and scaling, and community-building, helping projects align incentives, refine governance processes, and accelerate adoption among developers and users across ecosystems and developer communities. They view investing as more than a one-off transaction, staying with founders for the long haul through multiple rounds and phases of development to support ongoing work, governance, and durable ecosystem building.
